description: This PHP source file defines a class 'ConfigurationProvider' within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically handling retry configuration provisioning. It provides methods to generate configuration objects from environment variables, configuration files, or fallback defaults, and supports composition and caching of providers.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: Provides various methods to create retry configurations for AWS SDK operations, including environment-based, file-based, fallback defaults, and configuration composition with caching capabilities.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment variables, configuration files, and fallback options, with optional caching.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that sources settings from environment variables AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS and AWS_RETRY_MODE.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides default retry configuration if no other sources are available.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider from an INI file, using a specified profile and filename.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Converts various configuration representations into a ConfigurationInterface instance.
